subject: general
question:
If in each of the following words, each letter is changed to the previous letter in the English alphabetical order, how many words thus formed will have a vowel?

JUST, RIME, BEST, FAST, LOST, TIME
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/349d9345aa6566e72437f9f4bc00c4e55d34ec26ae0f9355a10b7dcb5695395a.png] 

Given words: JUST, RIME, BEST, FAST, LOST, TIME

By each letter is changed to the previous letter in the English alphabetical order. We got,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a089e2437858f1d6b83801c26ff1868f8ff30895e313e9bd4a5c4ba21f125b6.png] 

Here, **Three words** thus formed will have a vowel.

Hence, **'Option 3'** is the correct answer.
